summary: Audit of Phase S4 at d6b60a19, over the 25-commit range 85208f3a..d6b60a19. Verdict: PASS, with six record-only findings for the S5 list. (1) The format commit dec3be20 is format-only and I proved it: a detached worktree at the parent a468fa96, formatted with the repo's .oxfmtrc.json, yields exactly the 3499 files of dec3be20 with byte-identical content, after the two passes that oxfmt 0.78.0 needs for 4 files. The commit holds zero paths that match an ignorePatterns entry and none of the six dirty generated paths. .oxfmtrc.json (e5f474b5) holds $schema and the 17 patterns of plan.md:452; oxfmt is pinned to the exact 0.78.0 in root devDependencies; the lockfile has one node_modules/oxfmt key at 0.78.0; the root format and format:check scripts have the target values; .git-blame-ignore-revs (2046b47f) works (plain blame package.json:47 gives dec3be20, the ignore file gives ccfe3571). (2) The test fix e65553da keeps each assertion's meaning: all 12 files pass (bus-math-v2 6, integrated-math-2 2, integrated-math-3 92 in 7 files). The three quote-tolerant changes are bounded: the IM2 script rewrites use the formatted tokens only; the IM3 teacher-flow pattern uses one quote pair and one value with the set of keys and values unchanged; the IM3 seed helper builds the exact inline or 10-space layout per record, so a wrong flag fails the toContain. The CSS matcher is narrower (anchored, m flag), not wider. (3) The key() refinement 39ce245f changes only key(); the exit-code comparison is intact. Over every recorded log (baseline, baseline-m2, s1, s1-premerge, s2, s3, s4) all 2021 ' FAIL ' title lines survive key(), and every s4 test log and step log yields zero keys absent from baseline-m2. DISK_FULL_RE (97ef1021) adds the two full-line anchored forms; the three guard cases and the 23 other cases of the file pass (26 of 26). (4) The five S4 Red cases pass for the right reason: -t 'S4 oxfmt' gives 5 passed, 90 skipped. Case 5 parses the labeled count 'on (\d+) files' and requires 1; my mutants reproduce the Red retry claims (bad probe exit 1 and names the probe, missing target exit 2 with the absent-target phrase, clean probe exit 0 with 'on 1 files'). Case 2 compares exact script values; case 3 checks a 40-character SHA and the commit subject. (5) Plan and evidence numbers match the artifacts: 3499 files, 3717 scanned, audit critical=0 high=9 moderate=7 low=5, test steps scripts-suite 1 and audit-suites 1, scripts suite 94 passed and 1 failed of 95, audit-suites 5 failed in 2 files, fixture canonical JSON equal with 49 entries, format:check exit 0, doctor exit 0, no push (HEAD is 26 ahead of origin/master). The six findings are prose claims that the artifacts contradict and hide no failure: the fixture IS in the format commit; the plan says 18 ignorePatterns where the file and the plan list hold 17; 'the typecheck sweep holds the baseline exit codes' is false for 3 workspaces; the idempotence sentence omits that 4 files need a second pass; the anchor falsification of the refutation case does not hold; and the strategy S4 CI risk row contradicts its own yml fact row.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Minor] review-a: oxc-evidence.md:247 says 'The typecheck sweep and the build sweep hold the baseline exit codes'. The typecheck sweep does not hold them: gates/baseline-m2/typecheck.exit and gates/s4/typecheck.exit differ in 3 workspaces (apps/bus-math-v2 n/a->0, apps/integrated-math-3 2->1, apps/pre-calculus 2->1). The baseline step typecheck-bm2 (0) is also absent from s4/checks-all.steps, because apps/bus-math-v2 now has a typecheck script. The build sweep does hold (0 diffs). Rationale: the gate result NEWFAIL=0 is still correct, because every difference is an improvement or a new script and the sweep compares keys for the 2->1 workspaces, so no failure is hidden. Record-only: correct the sentence at the next evidence touch.

F2 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:518 says 'The fixture file is not in the format commit'. The fixture is in it: dec3be20 reformats scripts/__tests__/fixtures/lint-disable-allowlist.json (raw text changes, canonical JSON equal, 49 entries). Rationale: test-strategy 17.1 itself lists the fixture in the pre-format change set (log line 3427). The canonical compare still proves the semantic content is unchanged, so this hides no failure. Record-only.

F3 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:479 says '$schema plus the 18 ignorePatterns of line 452'. The config and the plan list at plan.md:452 hold 17 patterns. Rationale: a wrong count in evidence invites a false mismatch check later. The file matches the target list exactly. Record-only.

F4 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:550 says 'npm run format is idempotent (the second run changed nothing)'. From the pre-format tree one pass leaves 4 files that a second pass changes: apps/danielson/lib/foundation/admin-route.ts, apps/integrated-math-3/__tests__/convex/selected-worked-lesson-consumer.test.tsx, apps/pre-calculus/__tests__/components/student/PrecalculusTopic11DailyCurriculumPilot.red.test.tsx, and packages/activity-components/src/schemas/discriminant-analyzer.schema.ts. The committed content equals the second-pass output and is a fixed point: npm run format:check exits 0 and a further pass changes nothing. Rationale: a developer who runs one pass after an edit can see format:check fail, so the sentence overstates the tool. It hides no gate failure, because CI and the gate read the committed tree. Record-only: state 'the second run reached the fixed point'.

F5 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:474 and test-strategy.md:1685 give the falsification 'remove the anchors and the refutation case fails'. The refutation line is ' FAIL  __tests__/disk.test.ts > handles the spawn ENOSPC write path'; the unanchored alternative Error: spawn (ENOSPC|EDQUOT) still requires the literal 'Error: ' before 'spawn', so removing the anchors leaves the case green. Rationale: the case does catch an alternative without the 'Error: ' prefix, but it does not test the anchors. The anchoring has a real effect only on a bare line that starts with the message. Record-only: name the discriminating input, or drop the second half of the claim.

F6 [Nit] review-a: test-strategy.md:1617 (S4 risk row) says the S4 diff 'has no .github/workflows/ path and no measure/ path other than the run log and the evidence file'. The phase diff holds 5 formatted workflow YAML files (js-yaml parses each side to an equal object) and the plan-required measure paths measure/tech-stack.md, plan.md, oxc-evidence.md, and gates.sh. Rationale: the row contradicts the strategy's own fact row (6 yml files in the change set) and would make a reviewer flag planned edits as scope breaks. Record-only for S5.

F7 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:610 and oxc-evidence.md:284 say 'the before sweep still holds its 33 S4 keys'. No artifact supports a re-check: the after sweep with label s4 overwrote the before-sweep logs under gates/s4 (test logs dated 19:53 to 20:11, after the 18:50 fix), so the 33-key set exists only as a sentence in the Green log jr-green-s4-93181be8.log. Rationale: I re-derived the no-loss property independently over every recorded log (2021 FAIL lines, 0 lost) and the after run yields zero new keys, so the substance holds and no failure is hidden. Record-only: keep the before logs under a separate label next time.

ratings.evidence: The format commit is format-only and exact: the parent worktree formatted with the repo config reproduces all 3499 files byte for byte (0 set differences), format:check exits 0, and no runtime change appears (js-yaml and CSS token compares equal); the only edge is the 4 files that need a second pass.

The 5 S4 cases and 3 classifier cases are real: case 5 parses 'on (\d+) files' and requires 1, case 2 compares exact script values, case 3 checks a 40-character SHA with the commit subject, and the mutants fail as claimed; the guard refutation case does not test the anchors as its falsification text says (F5).

The phase diff outside the format commit is exactly the 12 test files of e65553da, .git-blame-ignore-revs, gates.sh, plan.md, oxc-evidence.md, and the run logs; no production source changed after dec3be20 and the 6 dirty generated files stayed unstaged.

Most numbers reproduce (3499 files, 3717 scanned, 94+1 of 95, 5 failed of 192, 49 entries, audit 0/9/7/5, 26 guard cases, 5 S4 cases), but 5 prose claims do not match the artifacts (F1 to F5) and one proof artifact was overwritten (F7).
